body.stringValue: The courtyard was still cool after the night rain. I watered the small herb pots, made tea, and wrote down one thing I wanted to finish before lunch.
Nia and Rowan met beneath the paper lanterns at Juniper Arcade, a made-up place in this sample story. They traded ideas for a tiny community garden and agreed to sketch a plan over the weekend.
A warm mug, a clear desk, and a few minutes without notifications made the afternoon feel spacious. I want to keep this simple routine for the next writing session.
